name: doodad-open-z-hammerfall
description: smoketest_maps blizzard/(2)Hammerfall_S3.w3x opened in the terrain view and saved after an empty edit. The World Editor keeps every stored height (they are its own ground); Studio's Fix Doodads on Load rewrote its 13 stone walls LTw0..LTw3 (Elevation Sample Radius 50) until branch doodad-open-z-we (2026-11-16: lib/terrain/w3e.ts rampLift, objheights.ts doodadGround's sample radius, floats by the skin).

steps.eval: const s = await w3.services.get('w3.terrain'); for (let i = 0; i < 60 && !s.placedObjects()?.doodads?.length; i++) await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 500)); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 1500)); window.__driveEd.pushEdit({ undo() {}, redo() {}, terrain: false, objects: false });
